frequency_question: How often do agreements to renew existing transboundary water treaties successfully reach formal signature and official announcement within their designated expiration windows?
membership_rule: Includes any formal bilateral or multilateral treaty concerning shared river basins where an expiring agreement requires explicit renewal or replacement; excludes unilateral declarations or informal cooperation frameworks.

cases.name: Senegal River Basin Development Organization conventions

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named key transboundary water treaty renewals and foundational signatures; believed virtually all major historical instances of high-level intergovernmental water treaties meeting formal renewal criteria when substantive intent exists.
known_gaps: Minor technical protocols or undocumented local basin amendments may exist outside major state archives.
validity_reason: Bilateral hydro-diplomacy norms and state behaviors regarding vital shared river basins evolve slowly over decades.
